title: Clarity of controls, explanations, and solutions
summary: This topic loosely groups comments about whether issues, controls, or product behaviors are explained or understood clearly, with many fragments too context-poor to assign a firm opinion.

positive.summary: The positive feedback praises a staff member as clearly helpful rather than the vehicle itself.

negative.summary: Negative feedback points to unclear issue visibility, an inconvenient or painful solution, and lacking tactile feel.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention clearer range information, visible buttons, interior quality, audio behavior, regeneration explanations, and vague statements about something being wrong or already solved without enough context for a firm sentiment.

limitations: The cluster mixes several unrelated subjects, including staff helpfulness, controls, tactile feel, range information, audio behavior, interior quality, and regeneration behavior.
Most fragments are undetermined and brief, so the underlying issue and sentiment are often not clear enough to support a tighter theme.
Some examples refer to people or service interactions rather than the vehicle, which limits topic coherence.
